actorContexts.actor: Public visitor / assessment capability holder
actorContexts.minimumAuthority: public route or purpose-bound bearer; no private session

actorContexts.actor: Invited recipient / onboarding principal
actorContexts.minimumAuthority: valid recipient-bound invitation, verified identity, expiry and MFA

actorContexts.actor: Member, grievant or represented person
actorContexts.minimumAuthority: active membership plus separate creator/represented-person relationship

actorContexts.actor: Former, suspended or revoked member or staff
actorContexts.minimumAuthority: revocation and live authority re-evaluation; no inherited access

actorContexts.actor: Assigned representative / specialized representative
actorContexts.minimumAuthority: active membership plus explicit case grant; capacity and scope

actorContexts.actor: Senior representative / supervisor
actorContexts.minimumAuthority: accepted supervisory mandate, named resource scope and action

actorContexts.actor: Officer / executive / successor
actorContexts.minimumAuthority: valid office or delegated mandate; succession and outgoing revocation

actorContexts.actor: Union operations clerk / authorized correspondence staff
actorContexts.minimumAuthority: action-specific staff authority; draft, approve and dispatch separated

actorContexts.actor: Tenant organization administrator / access custodian
actorContexts.minimumAuthority: active canonical admin membership; no implicit case access

actorContexts.actor: Governance, privacy handler, independent reviewer or auditor
actorContexts.minimumAuthority: specific review or assurance grant, independence and recusal

actorContexts.actor: Financial officer / trustee
actorContexts.minimumAuthority: explicit financial mandate; base finance positive workflows excluded

actorContexts.actor: National union, federation, CLC / affiliate representative
actorContexts.minimumAuthority: explicit delegated organization/resource authority; hierarchy alone insufficient

actorContexts.actor: Nzila platform operator / support / owner
actorContexts.minimumAuthority: canonical platform entitlement; scoped support, no tenant-content bypass

actorContexts.actor: External representative, specialist, WorkAid or counsel
actorContexts.minimumAuthority: verified external identity; matter authority/grant; separately consent and document/version scope

actorContexts.actor: Employer, respondent, witness, adverse party or external recipient
actorContexts.minimumAuthority: specific authorized disclosure/participation only; no ordinary case access

actorContexts.actor: Third-party data subject, dependent or member proxy
actorContexts.minimumAuthority: verified relationship or legal instrument; no self-asserted authority

actorContexts.actor: Identity provider / webhook / integration service principal
actorContexts.minimumAuthority: issuer/signature/audience and narrow service or resource scope

actorContexts.actor: Cron / queue worker / scanner / mail / storage / backup service
actorContexts.minimumAuthority: authenticated service identity; job, tenant and data purpose

actorContexts.actor: AI assistant / retrieval / automation / agent
actorContexts.minimumAuthority: delegated initiating principal and action scope; machine output is not institutional approval

actorContexts.actor: Anonymous, stale-session, forged, foreign-tenant or untrusted actor
actorContexts.minimumAuthority: refusal; no private disclosure or business mutation
